bread.label: BREAD
bread.line: Flour, water, salt and the starter, kneaded, proofed and baked.

pasta.label: PASTA
pasta.line: Flour and egg kneaded, rolled thin, cut to ribbons and boiled to the soul.

sheets.label: SHEETS
sheets.line: Folded and rolled until it is satin, then boiled.

noodles.label: NOODLES
noodles.line: Hand-pulled: kneaded, doubled and doubled again, boiled.

seafood.label: SEAFOOD
seafood.line: A fish you landed from the Lachryma, bled calm and seared skin down.

rice.label: RICE
rice.line: Rice rinsed clear and simmered in a donabe, the water to the line.

broth.label: BROTH
broth.line: Kombu simmered, never boiled, then steeped: add a fish for katsuobushi's inosinate and the umami doubles.

tea.label: TEA
tea.line: Water brought to the leaf's heat by its bubbles, and poured.

sear.label: SEAR
sear.line: Cut even, salted and seared in a hot pan until it lets go by itself.

sauce.label: SAUCE
sauce.line: A roux to the colour, whisked into a liquid and simmered.

emulsion.label: EMULSION
emulsion.line: Oil whisked into yolk in a thread, held warm, never boiled.

sweet.label: SWEET
sweet.line: Syrup taken off at the stage it is asked: thread, ball or crack.

ferment.label: FERMENT
ferment.line: Koji on warm rice, left on the game clock and tended; take it out before it spores.

smoke.label: SMOKE
smoke.line: Kept in thin blue smoke over a low fed fire.
